workflow_id.description: Existing workflow id. Source is stored under $OPENCTO_WORKSPACE/workflows/{workflow_id}.

items.description: Global env assignment NAME=value applied to every step. Runtime-owned OPENCTO_* names are reserved; steps receive OPENCTO_WORKFLOWS_DIR, OPENCTO_WORKFLOW_RUN_DIR, and OPENCTO_WORKFLOW_DATA_DIR.

command.description: Executable name or workflow-local executable path only. Put arguments in args and do not repeat the executable in args.

args.description: Optional command arguments. External commands such as python3 usually need args; workflow-local executable commands may omit args. Use OPENCTO_WORKFLOW_RUN_DIR/artifacts for same-run files and OPENCTO_WORKFLOW_DATA_DIR for cross-run data.

start_to_close_timeout.description: Maximum wall-clock time for one step attempt once it starts, using Go duration syntax. Examples: "30s" for quick API calls, "2m" for small scripts, "15m" for longer batch work.

schedule_to_close_timeout.description: Optional total deadline for the step including queueing and all retries, using Go duration syntax. Empty string means no separate total deadline. Set this when retries must finish within a business window; for example "5m" with start_to_close_timeout "1m", or "30m" for a longer batch step.

retry_policy.description: Optional retry settings. Omit to use runtime defaults.

initial_interval.description: Delay before the first retry after a step failure, using Go duration syntax. Empty string uses the runtime default. Examples: "5s" for transient API/network failures, "30s" when rate limits are likely, "1m" for slower external systems.

backoff_coefficient.description: Retry backoff multiplier. Use 0 for the runtime default, 1 for constant delay, or 2 for exponential backoff.

maximum_interval.description: Maximum delay between retry attempts, using Go duration syntax. Empty string uses the runtime default. Examples: "30s" for short workflows, "5m" for rate-limited APIs, "15m" for expensive external services.

maximum_attempts.description: Maximum attempts including the first try. Use 0 for the runtime default, 1 for no retries, or 3 for a common retry budget.

non_retryable_error_types.description: Optional. Use ["WorkflowStepFailed"] to make command failures non-retryable. Omit or use [] to allow retry attempts.

path.description: Workflow-owned source file path relative to workflows/{workflow_id}. May be outside src/. Must not target workflow.yml, .gitignore, .git, data, dependency/cache/build/output dirs, .DS_Store, or .log files.
